title: Is Gold a Hedge or a Safe Haven? An Analysis of Stocks, Bonds and Gold
evidence_summary: Defines hedge as average non/negative correlation and safe haven as non/negative correlation in market stress; reports Gold safe-haven behavior in extreme stock conditions and notes the effect can be short-lived.

title: Is gold a safe haven? International evidence
evidence_summary: Finds hedge/safe-haven properties differ across developed and emerging markets, so safe-haven behavior is not universal across countries.

title: The Golden Dilemma
evidence_summary: Argues Gold is an unreliable inflation hedge over practical investment horizons even if very long-run purchasing-power arguments can differ.

title: Explanatory mining for gold: Contrasting evidence from simple and multiple regressions
evidence_summary: Shows commonly attributed Gold properties can change between simple and multiple-regression settings; highlights USD and commodity-price channels.

title: Do gold prices respond to real interest rates? Evidence from the Bayesian Markov Switching VECM model
evidence_summary: Reports a regime-dependent real-rate/Gold relationship and a positive association in its G7 MS-VECM results, illustrating that the sign need not be universally inverse.
